title: "Maternal–Infant EHR Release: Structured Data & Clinical-Notes Metadata"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
params:
  release_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE)
dir <- params$release_dir
read_tbl <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(dir,paste0(name,".csv"))
  if (file.exists(path)) utils::read.csv(path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  else data.frame()
}
overview <- read_tbl("dataset_overview")
sites <- read_tbl("site_summary")
dates <- read_tbl("date_summary")
categories <- read_tbl("category_summary")
qc <- read_tbl("validation_summary")
manifest <- read_tbl("manifest")
network_checks <- read_tbl("network_verification")
source("code/run/00_pipeline_helpers.R",local=TRUE)
variable_dictionary <- ehr_variable_dictionary()
raw_inventory_files <- list.files(dir, pattern="^raw_source_inventory_[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{6}\\.csv$", full.names=TRUE)
if (length(raw_inventory_files)) raw_sources <- utils::read.csv(sort(raw_inventory_files,decreasing=TRUE)[1],stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
raw_read_files <- list.files(dir, pattern="^read_calls_review_[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{6}\\.csv$", full.names=TRUE)
raw_reads <- if (length(raw_read_files)) utils::read.csv(sort(raw_read_files,decreasing=TRUE)[1],stringsAsFactors=FALSE) else data.frame()
```

This report summarizes aggregate statistics from *explicitly pinned, checksum-verified* local RDA files. It contains **no clinical note text or patient-level records**. Maternal records are not multiplied across pregnancies. Laboratory extracts are included when explicitly listed in the release manifest and validated against the canonical linkage. Maternal laboratory events are not assigned to individual deliveries.

## Data provenance

Input paths and checksums below identify the source artifacts used for this report. This page is an operational release report; it does not establish encounter-specific maternal event assignment or prove clinical note text retrieval.

## Network output verification

The table compares each pinned local RDA with its network counterpart using MD5 checksums and checks for nonempty network CSV files. This is an observational audit; a missing file does not alter the 48 local-data validation checks.

```{r network-verification}
if (nrow(network_checks)) knitr::kable(network_checks) else cat("Network audit unavailable.")
```

## Remaining dependencies

- Maternal inpatient and outpatient medication rebuild scripts must be present and verified before claiming full raw-to-release reproducibility.
- Clinical-notes metadata must be independently crosswalked to actual clinical-note text.
- Laboratory identifier matching must remain fully validated when source extracts change; maternal laboratory events require separately validated pregnancy-specific assignment.
